hints.title: Product Maximization Principle
hints.text: For two positive numbers with fixed sum, their product is maximized when their difference is minimized.

hints.title: Bitwise Manipulation
hints.text: For bits i from n - 1 down to 0, if min(a, b) does not have bit 1 << i set, flipping bit i in both a and b increases min(a, b).

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic
hints.text: Perform bit operations on 64-bit integers and apply modulo 10^9 + 7 only at the final product step.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing n bit positions from n - 1 down to 0.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all 2^n values of x is exponential.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that setting bits in the smaller operand maximizes the product.
